doc_title_en: Financial Results for the Six-Month Period Ending June 2026 and Progress on Initiatives toward Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
doc_title_jp: 2026年12月期(会計期間1-6月)決算説明および資本コストや株価を意識した経営の実現に向けた対応についての進捗状況

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率と1株当たり価値の向上

summary_en: Nichirin updated its capital efficiency targets: DOE floor of 2.5%, dividend payout ratio of 45%, and annual dividend of 190 yen per share (95 yen interim + 95 yen year-end). The company plans to acquire and cancel up to 1.5 billion yen of treasury shares to enhance per-share value. Over 2026–2028, the company allocated 35 billion yen to capital: 20.5 billion yen for strategic investments, 13 billion yen for shareholder returns, and 1.5 billion yen for other purposes.
summary_jp: 資本効率指標としてDOE下限2.5%、配当性向目標45%を設定。1株当たり配当190円（中間95円＋期末95円）。自己株式を15億円上限で取得し消却する方針。2026～2028年の3年間で総額350億円を配分：戦略投資205億円、株主還元130億円、その他15億円。
